book.name: 1 TESALONICENSES
book.title: A JE' JU'UNA', CAJ U YɅN BAT'AN TS'IBTA PABLO TI' U YET ACSɅ'ORIROB ICH U CAJAR TESALÓNICA 1 TESALONICENSES

content: A ba' cu qui'quintic yor C'uj

Bin u ca' ts'ocar in wacob techex baje'rer, in bʌjobechex. Chich quin wacob techex quire' baxuc u c'at Jesucristo ca' in chich arej techex. Rajen quin chich c'aticob techex ca' a qui' cʌnex a ba' tin camsob techex ti' u t'ʌn C'uj quire' tan a sayʌrex tu pach Jesús.
Mʌ' wa c'aj techex a ba' tin camsexob, a ucho'? Rajen tin camsechexob quire' baxuc caj u toc araj Jesús ic Jaj Ts'urirex. Raji' a werex.
A C'ujo' u c'at techex ca' a cʌnex C'uj soc mʌna' a si'pirex, soc mʌ' a wacsiquex a si'pirex. A C'ujo' mʌ' u c'at yirechex a manex ich u c'asir mac.
A C'ujo' u c'at yiriquechex yejer a raq'uiri'e'. Tsoy yiric a C'ujo' wa maquix yʌn u raq'uirire'.
A C'ujo' mʌ' u c'at yirechex a manex yejer a xquic a mʌna' u mam, mʌ' tsoyi'. Mʌ' ja wirej, a mac a mʌ' yacsmʌnob tu yorob mʌ' yer C'uj, ra' cu pachticob xquic.
Mʌ' a yʌn cʌniquex a tus pʌyiquex u rac' a wet acsʌ'orirex. Mʌ' ja wirej, ic Jaj Ts'urirex jach manan yaj cu bin u ts'ajic muc'yaj a ti'o'. A teno' baxuc tin chich araj techex a ucho'.
A C'ujo' tu tetajo'onex soc mʌ' ic manex ich c'as. Mʌ' u c'at ij cʌxtiquex ic si'pirex. Tu chen tetajo'onex C'uj soc taj quij cacsex tij corex u t'ʌn C'uj.
A mac a cu p'astic a je' t'ʌna', a quin camsicob techex baje'rer. Mʌ' xib cu p'astiqui', C'uj cu p'astic. Ra'iri' a tu ts'aj to'onex u Taj'or u Pixam C'uj.

A ba' ta c'atex a tenobo' jach tsoy a yajquintiquex a wet acsʌ'orirex. Chen mʌ' ba'wir quin ts'ibticob techex ich ju'un. Mʌ' ja wirej, C'uj tu toc araj uch ca' a pacran yajquintex a bʌjex a wet acsʌ'orirex.

Mʌ' ja wirej, quin wiricob rajra' tan a yajquintiquechex tu cotor a wet acsʌ'orirex ich u ru'umin Macedonia. Chen a tenobo' in c'atob techex, in bʌjobechex soc jach manan a jach yajquintiquex a wet acsʌ'orirex. Raji' quin chich c'aticob techex.

Ca' a p'isex a bʌjex soc mʌna' ba' cu ya'aricob soc p'eri'i' a worex yejer a rac'obex. Bayiri' xan, ca' a p'isex a bʌjex quir a beyajex. Mʌ' tsoy a p'ʌtiquex a beyaj. Ca' a beyanʌquex a bʌjiri'ex. C'aj techex a tin toc arajob techexe' soc rajra' a beyajex.

A baywo' a mac a cu tar, a mʌ' yacsmʌnob tu yorob bin u ca' sʌj techex quire' a wacsmʌnex ta worex. Mʌ' ja wirej, yirob jach sac'orechex quire' toc yʌnex a wo'ochex. Rajen mʌ' ba' wir ca bin a c'atex a wo'ochex ich u jer mac.
Tan u tar Jesucristo

A tenobo', quij Pablo. In c'atob a werex, in bʌjobechex ba' u ber u quimrir a yacsmʌnob tu yorob. In c'at a werex ba' u ber ti' u quimrir soc mʌ' a wac'tiquex u quimrir, irechex a mac a mʌ' yacsmʌnob tu yorob. Rajen cu yac'ticob u bʌj quire' mʌ' u jach erob tu cu binob, rajen cu yac'ticob u bʌj.

Quire' quimij to'onex Jesús quire' raji' quij cacsiquex tij corex ti' Jesús. Quire' ric' to'onex tu quimrir Jesús quire' raji' quij cacsiquex tij corex ti' Jesús. Quet bayiri' quij cacsiquex tij corex ti' C'uj, raji' cu bin u ric'so'onex tij quimrirex a mac a yacsmʌnob tu yorobe'. Bin u pʌybir Jesús ca' bin wʌc'ʌs uruc tera'.

Rajen quin camsicob techex aro', quire' ra' u t'ʌn ic Jaj Ts'urirex Jesucristo. Mʌ' ja wirej, wa ti' yʌno'onex ca' bin uruc Jesús. Mʌ' pʌyber quic binex ca'anan quire' p'eri' ca' bin xico'onex yejer a mac a quimenob a yacsmʌnob tu yorob uch.

P'eri' ca' bin xicob yejero'onex. Mʌ' ja wirej, u bʌjiri' Jesús ca' bin wʌc'ʌs tac tera' ich yoc'ocab. Ta u tar ich ca'anan ca' bin tac. Jach c'am ca' bin yustej yejer u mascabir quir u yutsta'r. C'am ca' bin u t'ʌnej yʌjmasirob u t'ʌn C'uj quire' baxuc ara'b ten C'uj ti'ob soc c'am u t'ʌnic. A mac quimenob uch, a yacsmʌnob tu yorob raji'ob pʌyber cu yʌn riq'uir.

Caj ts'oc u riq'uirob a quimene', a cuxa'anobo' pachir ca' bin xicob a ti'obo'. Ti' quic bin ic much'quinbiro'onex ich ca'anan. P'eri' ca' bin much'quintaco'onex ich u muyarir yejer ic Jaj Ts'urirex. A baxuco' ti' yʌno'onex yejer ic Jaj Ts'urex munt q'uini'.
Rajen pacran qui'quintex a wor quire' je' tar Jesúse'.
